To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the share prices of USA listed Chinese companies audited by Chinese accounting firms responded negatively to the SEC's launch of the administrative proceedings against the Chinese accounting firms on 3rd December 2012.

share prices of USA listed Chinese companies that were audited by the Chinese auditors reacted negatively around the SEC launch of the administrative proceedings, the SEC Administrative Law Judge's ruling and the settlement of administrative proceedings.

share prices of USA listed companies audited by Chinese audit firms responded negatively to the SEC administrative actions against five Chinese audit firms for their refusal to hand over audit working papers to the SEC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how share prices responded to the SEC administrative proceeding against five Chinese auditors.
the impact of the administrative proceedings against the Chinese auditors on USA listed Chinese companies.
the impact of SEC administrative proceedings against five China-based accounting firms on the share prices of Chinese companies listed in USA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
share prices of USA listed Chinese companies audited by Chinese firms reacted negatively to the SEC administrative enforcement action.
the share prices of USA listed Chinese companies audited by the Chinese auditors reacted negatively around the SEC administrative proceedings announcement date.
Chinese companies with audit work papers not available to the SEC experienced significant negative stock price reaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SEC's administrative proceeding against Chinese auditors has a significant effect on the share prices of USA listed Chinese companies.
the share prices responded negatively to the SEC's administrative proceedings against Chinese accounting firms.
the SEC's administrative proceedings against five major Chinese accounting firms had a negative impact on the share prices of Chinese firms listed in the USA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SEC enforcement actions are effective in deterring the non audit failures.
share prices responded to the SEC's administrative proceedings against five major Chinese accounting firms, but not to the SEC Administrative Law Judge's ruling or the settlement of the proceedings.
investors reacted negatively to the SEC's administrative proceedings against Chinese accounting firms.
